## Architecture Overview

The `Host` interface is defined in `opentelemetry-collector/component/host.go` with a single method `GetExtensions() map[component.ID]component.Component`. Adding `GetExtension(id ID) (Component, bool)` requires updating all Host implementations and the 160+ files that call `GetExtensions()` across the OTel ecosystem.

## Detailed Analysis

### Interface Definition

- **`component/host.go`** — Defines the Host interface. Must add the new `GetExtension()` method.

### Host Implementations (Must Add Method)

- **`service/internal/graph/host.go`** — Main Host implementation in the service graph. Must implement `GetExtension()` delegating to ServiceExtensions.
- **`component/componenttest/nop_host.go`** — Test helper returning empty values. Must return `(nil, false)`.
- **`exporter/exporterhelper/internal/hosttest/hosttest.go`** — Mock host for testing exporters. Must implement lookup in ext map.

### Jaeger (Direct Extension Lookup Pattern)

- **`jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerstorage/extension.go`** — Uses `findExtension()` helper iterating `host.GetExtensions()` to locate storage extension by type. Can be refactored to use new method.
- **`jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerquery/extension.go`** — Uses `GetExtension()` helper iterating to find jaegerquery extension.
- **`jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/remotesampling/extension.go`** — Looks up storage extensions.
- **`jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/expvar/extension.go`** — Uses Host for extension discovery.

### OTel Collector Core (Key Callers)

- **`config/confighttp/client.go`** — Passes GetExtensions to auth extension lookups.
- **`config/confighttp/server.go`** — HTTP server auth extension lookups.
- **`config/configgrpc/configgrpc.go`** — gRPC auth extension lookups.
- **`exporter/otlpexporter/otlp.go`** — OTLP exporter using Host.
- **`receiver/otlpreceiver/otlp.go`** — OTLP receiver using Host.

### OTel Collector Contrib (90+ files)

Key extensions using Host:
- **`extension/httpforwarderextension/extension.go`** — Looks up auth extensions via GetExtensions().
- **`extension/jaegerremotesampling/extension.go`** — Remote sampling extension.
- **`extension/opampextension/auth.go`** — OpAMP auth lookups.

## Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| opentelemetry-collector | component/host.go | Host interface definition |
| opentelemetry-collector | service/internal/graph/host.go | Main Host implementation |
| opentelemetry-collector | component/componenttest/nop_host.go | Test helper Host |
| opentelemetry-collector | exporter/exporterhelper/internal/hosttest/hosttest.go | Mock Host for exporter tests |
| opentelemetry-collector | config/confighttp/client.go | HTTP client auth extension lookups |
| opentelemetry-collector | config/confighttp/server.go | HTTP server auth extension lookups |
| opentelemetry-collector | config/configgrpc/configgrpc.go | gRPC auth extension lookups |
| opentelemetry-collector | exporter/otlpexporter/otlp.go | OTLP exporter using Host |
| opentelemetry-collector | receiver/otlpreceiver/otlp.go | OTLP receiver using Host |
| jaeger | cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerstorage/extension.go | findExtension() iterating Host.GetExtensions() |
| jaeger | cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerquery/extension.go | GetExtension() helper iterating Host |
| jaeger | cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/remotesampling/extension.go | Storage extension lookup |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | extension/httpforwarderextension/extension.go | Auth extension lookups via GetExtensions() |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | extension/jaegerremotesampling/extension.go | Remote sampling via Host |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | extension/opampextension/auth.go | OpAMP auth lookups |
